entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A Sun Empire warrior and planeswalker who tells the emperor the truth about Orazca, is denied her oration, and leaves to gather stories on another world.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A minotaur planeswalker who planeswalks away once the Immortal Sun is gone.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: A River Herald elder who agrees to open negotiations with the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Vona of Iedo
entities.description: A vampire conquistador devastated by the loss of the Immortal Sun and by Saint Elenda's words.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: A vampire hierophant who defends Saint Elenda against Vona.

entities.name: Saint Elenda
entities.description: The living vampire saint who explains that her order was meant to guard, not use, the Immortal Sun and demands to be taken to Queen Miralda.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin pirate who asks where the Sun is and then flees.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A siren pirate who flees with Breeches.

entities.name: Emperor Apatzec
entities.description: The emperor of the Sun Empire who plans to invade Fort Adanto and refuses to let Huatli tell her true story.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: Huatli's cousin, who encourages her to travel and steals the warrior-poet's helm for her.

entities.name: Zacama
entities.description: A three-headed elder dinosaur that Huatli summons and rides to Pachatupa.

entities.name: Queen Miralda
entities.description: The queen of the Legion of Dusk's homeland to whom Elenda demands to be taken.

entities.name: Pedron the Wicked
entities.description: A figure the order wanted to protect the Immortal Sun from.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The artifact that vanishes beneath the characters, ending the barrier on planeswalking.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The unbound golden city, built with Sun Empire magic.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane now at peace after the Sun's departure.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The vampires' homeland conquered by the Legion.

entities.name: Pachatupa
entities.description: The Sun Empire's home city.

entities.name: Temple of the Burning Sun
entities.description: The temple in Pachatupa where the emperor receives Huatli.

entities.name: Fort Adanto
entities.description: A Legion of Dusk fort in the south that the emperor plans to invade.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The dinosaur-riding empire led by Apatzec.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: The merfolk open to negotiation with the Sun Empire.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire order whose purpose Elenda says was forgotten.

events.summary: The Immortal Sun vanishes and Huatli, Tishana, Vona and Angrath fall into the room below.
events.quote: The Immortal Sun vanished beneath their feet

events.summary: Angrath curses the plane and planeswalks away, free at last.
events.quote: SEE YOU NEVER, PATHETIC FOOLS!

events.summary: Huatli realizes both the Immortal Sun and the barrier are gone.
events.quote: Both the Immortal Sun and the barrier.

events.summary: Vona cries out that the Immortal Sun is gone.
events.quote: The Immortal Sun is gone!

events.summary: Breeches and Malcolm decide to run away.
events.quote: RUNNING AWAY!

events.summary: Saint Elenda arrives and asks whether the Immortal Sun is gone.
events.quote: Is it gone, children of night?

events.summary: Elenda accepts the Sun is gone for good and tells her followers they are free.
events.quote: No, my child. We are free. It is gone forever.

events.summary: Elenda reveals she ended her journey centuries ago upon finding Orazca.
events.quote: My journey ended centuries ago, when I found this place.

events.summary: Elenda explains her order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not use it, and that she sealed herself away here.
events.quote: Our order was meant to guard the Immortal Sun, not to use it.

events.summary: Vona says they conquered Torrezon and built an empire in Elenda's honor.
events.quote: We conquered Torrezon,

events.summary: Huatli urges Elenda to return home and tell her own story.
events.quote: You must be the one to tell your story. Not them.

events.summary: Elenda demands to be taken to Queen Miralda.
events.quote: Take me to Queen Miralda,

events.summary: Mavren Fein slices Vona's cheek for insulting Elenda.
events.quote: Do not speak ill of a living saint!

events.summary: Elenda forces Vona to the floor with a magical command.
events.quote: Elenda snapped her fingers angrily and Vona's knees buckled

events.summary: The three vampires leave into the night.
events.quote: the three vampires exited into the night.

events.summary: Tishana declares Orazca found and Ixalan at peace.
events.quote: Orazca is found

events.summary: Huatli says Orazca belongs to no one and should be shared.
events.quote: Orazca belongs to no one,

events.summary: Tishana agrees the River Heralds are open to negotiation.
events.quote: Yes. The River Heralds are.

events.summary: Huatli summons an elder dinosaur through the city's power.
events.quote: The threefold roar of an elder dinosaur filled her ears, and Huatli smiled.

events.summary: Huatli arrives in Pachatupa riding the elder dinosaur Zacama.
events.quote: Zacama was not intelligent per se, but she was somehow aware that she had a name

events.summary: Emperor Apatzec asks if Huatli found Orazca.
events.quote: I take it you found Orazca?

events.summary: Huatli's family embraces her on her return.
events.quote: They all tackled Huatli in an embrace

events.summary: Apatzec tells Huatli she has accomplished what he asked and will receive the warrior-poet title.
events.quote: You accomplished what I asked,

events.summary: Huatli tells the emperor the truth, including that Orazca should no longer be theirs.
events.quote: She did not try to tell him what he would want to hear.

events.summary: Apatzec refuses to let Huatli tell that story.
events.quote: That is not the story I want you to tell tomorrow.

events.summary: Apatzec reveals he is weeks away from invading Fort Adanto.
events.quote: We are weeks away from invading Fort Adanto in the south.

events.summary: Apatzec decrees the ceremony will have no oration by Huatli.
events.quote: The ceremony will happen as planned, but there will be no oration alongside it.

events.summary: Huatli demonstrates planeswalking to her family, who are ecstatic.
events.quote: when she demonstrated by vanishing and reappearing a moment later with a rock from another world in her hand, they were ecstatic.

events.summary: Inti convinces Huatli her destiny does not lie in Pachatupa.
events.quote: Your destiny does not lie here.

events.summary: Huatli's family steals the helm of the warrior-poet for her.
events.quote: with Inti wearing the helm on his head and a foolhardy smile on his face.

events.summary: Inti tells Huatli her duty is to gather stories from beyond the empire.
events.quote: You are the warrior-poet. It is your duty to gather stories.

events.summary: Huatli planeswalks to another world to gather stories.
events.quote: Huatli stepped forward into another world.

relations.note: They part as friends with an agreement to negotiate.

relations.quote: Her cousin gave her a deadly serious look.
Our empire cannot grow if we do not expand.

relations.note: He defends and obeys the living saint.
relations.quote: Do not speak ill of a living saint!

relations.note: She sealed herself in Orazca to stand sentinel over the Sun.
relations.quote: to use my power to stand sentinel here

relations.note: Huatli completed the emperor's mission but defies his agenda.
Huatli commands the elder dinosaur as a mount.
relations.quote: Commanding Zacama was different than any mount Huatli had ever directed before.

relations.note: Vona insults Elenda and is cut by Mavren.
relations.quote: I'll speak ill of whoever I please!
